site.name: Notes
site.tagline_zh: 前沿技术的阅读笔记。事实、推断、观点分开写；每个数字都带出处。
site.tagline_en: Reading notes on frontier technology. Facts, inferences and opinions kept apart — every number carries a source.

starter_band.label_zh: 入门科普 · 先看这五篇
starter_band.note_zh: 读不下去就从这几篇开始：配置怎么分钱、60/40 是不是最优、黄金到底管不管用、VIX 该不该贪婪。
starter_band.note_en: If the list looks long, start here: how a portfolio splits its money, whether the 60/40 is actually best, whether gold hedges, and whether high VIX means buy.

items.blurb_zh: 最有名的配置规则：60% 这个数字比 40–50% 更差，崩在股债同跌。
items.blurb_en: The most famous rule — 60% is worse than 40–50%, and it breaks when stocks and bonds fall together.

items.blurb_zh: 四等分资金＝等风险；但通胀那一格它没扛住。
items.blurb_en: Equal money, nearly equal risk — but it failed the inflation test.

items.blurb_zh: 更稳，却没跑赢 60/40；风险其实压在长债上。
items.blurb_en: Steadier than a 60/40, no better on return, with the risk sitting in bonds.

items.blurb_zh: 58 年确实跑赢通胀，但 1980 年买的人等了 45 年。
items.blurb_en: It did beat inflation — a January 1980 buyer waited 45 years.

items.blurb_zh: 「别人恐惧我贪婪」站得住，但 36 年只给了 7 次机会。
items.blurb_en: Greedy when others are fearful holds up — on seven chances in 36 years.

notes.title_zh: 60/40 及其变体：最有名的配置规则经得起检验吗
notes.title_en: The 60/40, tested: does the most famous allocation rule hold up?
notes.summary_zh: 用 1990-01 至 2025-09 共 428 个月的美国数据回测 60/40 及其变体。它年化 9.09%、波动 9.1%、最大回撤 −27.0%、夏普 0.70——而 60% 这个数字恰好落在最差的区间：40–50% 的夏普同为 0.72，最大回撤只有 −21.5%。它真正的失效场景是股债同跌：2022 年两条腿各跌 18.1%，全样本有 13.5% 的月份两条腿同时下跌，CPI 高于 5% 时相关性从 −0.04 翻到 +0.38。把 10% 挪给黄金是最便宜的修补（夏普 0.76、回撤 −22.7%，代价是终值少 4.2%）。含 10 张图表（其中 1 张可拖动股票权重）与 2 张附录表。
notes.summary_en: 428 monthly US observations from 1990-01 to 2025-09 test the 60/40 and its variants: 9.09% a year, 9.1% volatility, a −27.0% maximum drawdown and a 0.70 Sharpe. Sixty percent sits in the worst part of the curve — a 40/60 or 50/50 has the same 0.72 Sharpe with a −21.5% drawdown. What breaks it is stocks and bonds falling together: both legs lost 18.1% in 2022, 13.5% of all months saw both fall, and the correlation flips from −0.04 to +0.38 once CPI is above 5%. Shifting 10% into gold is the cheapest repair (Sharpe 0.76, drawdown −22.7%, at a 4.2% cost to terminal wealth).

notes.title_zh: 趋势跟踪实测：它是一份保险，不是一台发动机
notes.title_en: Trend following, tested: insurance, not an engine
notes.summary_zh: 用 11 个 ETF、4,931 个交易日检验跨资产时序动量。信号本身有效（方向命中率 53%，30 组参数全为正），但做空那条腿在长牛资产上一直赔钱：多空夏普 0.38、只做多 0.58，都跑不赢 60/40 的 0.75。它真正的价值在坏日子——标普最差 10% 的交易日里跌幅只有 60/40 的八分之一，2022 年 +13.9% 对 −16.6%。含 7 张图表与一个可拖目标波动率的交互动画，配套代码与 chart pack 已开源。
notes.summary_en: 11 ETFs and 4,931 trading days test cross-asset time-series momentum. The signal works (a 53% direction hit rate, all 30 parameter sets positive), but the short leg bleeds in a universe that mostly rises: long-short Sharpe 0.38, long-only 0.58, against 0.75 for a 60/40. Its value is conditional — one eighth of the 60/40's loss on the worst 10% of days, and +13.9% in 2022 against −16.6%.

notes.title_zh: 全天候组合实测：不预测，真的能穿越周期吗
notes.title_en: All Weather, tested: does not forecasting actually survive every cycle?
notes.summary_zh: 用 1990-01 至 2025-09 共 428 个月的美国数据检验全天候组合的公开描述。它年化 7.6%、波动 7.6%、最大回撤 −22.3%，比 60/40 稳得多（9.2% / −29.6%），但收益更低（8.9%）夏普更差（0.64 对 0.68）。更关键的是它并没有做到环境中性：40% 的长债贡献了 53.5% 的风险，商品腿只有 1.2%。含 6 张图表与 1 个可拖股票权重的交互动画。
notes.summary_en: 428 monthly US observations test the public description of All Weather: 7.6% a year, −22.3% maximum drawdown, steadier than a 60/40 but with lower return and Sharpe. It is not environment-neutral — long bonds carry 53.5% of the risk while commodities carry 1.2%.

notes.summary_zh: 用 1990-01 至 2026-08 共 432 个月的美国数据检验「投资能跑赢通胀」。股票年化实际收益 8.4%、债券 1.9%、现金只有 0.1%——最初的 100 元 36 年后只值 102 元，而且持有 20 年仍有六成窗口跑输通胀。2022 年通胀 6.5% 时五类资产实际收益全为负。含 6 张图表与 1 个可拖持有期的交互动画。
notes.summary_en: 432 monthly US observations test whether investing beats inflation. Real annualised returns: equities 8.4%, bonds 1.9%, cash just 0.1% — 100 units of cash became 102 after 36 years, and cash still trailed inflation in 59.9% of twenty-year windows. In 2022 all five assets lost in real terms.

notes.title_zh: 错过最好的十天：一句被误用的统计
notes.title_en: The ten best days: a statistic used the wrong way
notes.summary_zh: 用标普 500 从 1970 年至今 14,309 个交易日检验「错过最好的 10 天，收益腰斩」。全仓年化 8.10%，错过最好 10 天降到 6.52%——但躲过最差 10 天升到 10.12%，幅度还更大。随机剔除 10 天则几乎没影响，而最好的日子与最差的日子只隔几天。含 6 张图表与 1 个可拖天数的交互动画。
notes.summary_en: 14,309 trading days test the claim that missing the ten best days halves your return. Buy-and-hold compounds at 8.10% and missing the best ten cuts it to 6.52% — but avoiding the worst ten lifts it to 10.12%, a bigger move. Missing ten random days changes almost nothing, and the best days sit days away from the worst.

notes.title_zh: 黄金：抗通胀，还是抗波动？
notes.title_en: Gold: an inflation hedge, or a volatility hedge?
notes.summary_zh: 以 1968-01 至 2026-08 共 703 个月的伦敦金价与美国 CPI 检验「黄金抗通胀」。58 年看它确实跑赢（实际购买力 12.5 倍），但 1980 年买在高点要等 45 年才回本，持有十年有四成窗口是亏的。它真正对冲的是组合波动：与股票相关性 −0.08，加入 10% 可把最大回撤从 28.4% 降到 24.6%。含 7 张图表与 1 个可拖权重的交互动画。
notes.summary_en: 703 monthly observations of the London gold price and US CPI test the claim that gold hedges inflation. Over 58 years real purchasing power rose 12.5-fold — but a January 1980 buyer waited 45 years to break even, and 40% of ten-year windows lost money after inflation.

notes.title_zh: VIX 冲上 30 的时候，该贪婪吗？
notes.title_en: When VIX tops 30, should you be greedy?
notes.summary_zh: 「别人恐惧我贪婪」在收益层面站得住：VIX ≥ 30 之后 12 个月的中位收益是 21.8%。但 36 年半里这样的机会只有 7 个互不重叠的市场阶段，其中一次买入后两年仍在亏损。含 8 张图表与 1 个可拖阈值的交互动画。
notes.summary_en: "Be greedy when others are fearful" survives on returns: the median 12-month return after VIX ≥ 30 is 21.8%. But 36 years produced only seven independent episodes, one of which was still losing money two years later.

notes.title_zh: 定投与一次性投入：基于 942 个月度观测的实证检验
notes.title_en: Dollar-cost averaging vs lump sum: evidence from 942 monthly observations
notes.summary_zh: 研究工作稿：以标普 500 全收益与恒生指数共 942 个月度观测检验一次性投入与分期定额投入（DCA）。一次性投入在约八成起点占优，其劣势几乎全部集中于「部署期下跌」的样本；换到恒生指数，优势降至 63–69%。含 9 张图表与 2 个交互动画，文末附参考文献。
notes.summary_en: A working paper on DCA versus lump sum using 942 monthly observations across two markets: all-in wins about 80% of starts, and its losses concentrate in falling deployment windows.

notes.title_zh: 约束的代价：多资产组合里，每个"不许超"都在收费
notes.summary_zh: 同样 8% 波动预算下，四条典型机构约束一共拿走 46.8 bps/年；但样本短的时候，同样的约束是保险而不是成本。四张图 + 八条可点开的文献。
notes.summary_en: Four ordinary institutional constraints cost 46.8 bps at an identical risk budget — and act as insurance when the sample is short.

notes.title_zh: 因子筛选：为什么样本内 1.95 的漂亮结果，样本外会归零
notes.title_en: Factor screening: why an in-sample Sharpe of 1.95 can be worth zero
notes.summary_zh: 同一份模拟数据，强弱两档信噪比：弱信号下按 t 值挑出的前 10 名，样本内夏普 1.95、样本外 0.03。附「证明一个因子需要多少年数据」的门槛计算与 11 条可点开的文献。
notes.summary_en: Two signal-to-noise regimes on the same simulation: with a weak signal, the top ten factors by t-statistic earn 1.95 in sample and 0.03 out of sample.

notes.title_zh: 术语表：System One · RLCD · 校准 · 类型安全
notes.title_en: Glossary: System One, RLCD, calibration, type safety
notes.summary_zh: 本文里出现的每个术语，给一句话定义、一个「为什么重要」和一条出处。其他笔记直接引用这里的锚点。
notes.summary_en: Every term used in these notes: a one-line definition, why it matters, and a source anchor other notes link to.

notes.title_zh: AI 挖因子，谁来当裁判
notes.title_en: Let the agent propose; let the referee judge
notes.summary_zh: 2026 年 9 月三篇论文指向同一件事：提议可以交给 AI，裁判不能。含机制流程图与三张模拟图：边看边停每千提案错误放行 205 个，冻结裁判只有 39 个，代价是等待时间。
notes.summary_en: Three September 2026 papers point at one division of labour: let the agent propose, keep the referee outside. 205 vs 39 wrongful admissions per 1,000 proposals — the difference is who judges.

notes.title_zh: Jev 与 System One Models：把 AI 变成代码里的一个判断
notes.title_en: Jev and System One Models: turning AI into a decision inside your code
notes.summary_zh: 它不是「更聪明的分类器」，而是一类新的接口：非结构化状态进，带校准概率的类型化决策出。本文拆开它的定义、机制、与 LLM 的差别、能落地的位置，以及哪些话目前只能算官方口径。
notes.summary_en: Not a smarter classifier — a new interface: unstructured state in, typed decisions with calibrated probabilities out.

notes.title_zh: Sell in May：季节性到底是不是真的
notes.title_en: Sell in May: is the seasonality real?
notes.summary_zh: 把几十年的月度收益铺成一张热力图，季节形状一眼可见。但可见不等于可交易：扣除成本、换手与多重检验之后，还剩多少。
notes.summary_en: Decades of monthly returns as a heat map make the seasonal shape obvious. Visible is not the same as tradeable: what survives costs, turnover and multiple testing.

notes.title_zh: 永久组合实测：四等分真的能应对任何环境吗
notes.title_en: The Permanent Portfolio, tested: does an even split cover every environment?
notes.summary_zh: 股、长债、黄金、现金各 25%，用 1990-01 至 2025-09 共 428 个月的美国数据检验。它年化 7.18%、波动 5.8%、最大回撤 −15.5%、夏普 0.75，是四个组合里最高的；25% 的资金对应 37.5 / 33.9 / 28.4 / 0.2 的风险贡献——四等分资金意外地做到了等风险。但 CPI 高于 5% 的 26 个月里它年化 −2.8%，黄金腿 −2.95%，它并没有抗住通胀。含 8 张图表与一个可拖黄金权重、可播放历史的交互动画。
notes.summary_en: 25% each in stocks, long bonds, gold and cash, tested on 428 monthly US observations from 1990-01 to 2025-09: 7.18% a year, 5.8% volatility, a −15.5% maximum drawdown and the highest Sharpe of the four portfolios (0.75). Equal money turns out to be very nearly equal risk (37.5 / 33.9 / 28.4 / 0.2) — but it lost 2.8% a year across the 26 months with CPI above 5%, with gold at −2.95%.
